overview.en:
Research and prioritize accounts using Actively's persistent Per-Account Agent intelligence, buying signals, prospect context, strategy, and next-best actions.

Research companies and people against a defined prospecting goal. Preserve the source of each finding and use available relationship or account context to prepare outreach drafts.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
分析客户账户、购买信号与潜在商机，制定销售优先级和后续行动。

围绕明确的获客目标研究企业与人物，保留每项发现的来源，并结合可用关系或客户背景准备触达草稿。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review my customer accounts and prioritize follow-up opportunities.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 分析我的客户账户，按优先级整理需要跟进的商机。

starterPrompts.en: Identify buying signals in my accounts and explain why they matter.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 找出客户账户中的购买信号，并说明判断依据。

starterPrompts.en: Help me prepare a follow-up plan for a target account.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 帮我为一个目标客户制定后续跟进计划。
